rationale: Parth brings hands-on hardware testing expertise from Tesla's TeslaBot humanoid robot program, while Dhanush is building robotics solutions as a founder with deep software architecture and perception skills (ROS, OpenCV, Python). They're both embedded in robotics but coming from complementary angles — hardware validation vs. full-stack robotics development — making this a natural knowledge exchange on real-world robot implementation.
intro_message: Parth Behani, meet Dhanush Baktha — you're both working in robotics but from different vantage points (hardware testing at Tesla vs. founding a robotics solutions company), and could trade insights on bringing perception and hardware together.
